steps.en: Install it where you work — editor extension, terminal CLI, or desktop app
steps.zh: 装在你干活的地方：编辑器扩展、终端 CLI 或桌面端

steps.en: Point it at a model — your own provider key, a gateway, or a local model
steps.zh: 接上一个模型：自己的 key、网关或本地模型

steps.en: Describe the job in Plan mode, and write down the project rules it must follow
steps.zh: 在 Plan 模式里说清任务，写下它必须遵守的项目规则

steps.en: Reads the repo, asks its questions, and lays out a strategy — changing nothing yet
steps.zh: 读仓库、提问、给出方案——此时一个文件都不改

steps.en: Switch to Act mode and approve each edit and command it proposes
steps.zh: 切到 Act 模式，逐条批准它提议的改动和命令

steps.en: Edits across files, runs your tests and build, and fixes the linter errors it caused
steps.zh: 跨文件改代码、跑测试和构建，并修掉自己引发的报错

steps.en: Checkpoints every step, so you can review any diff or roll the whole run back
steps.zh: 每一步都打 checkpoint，diff 可回看，整轮可回滚

value.en: Agent-speed edits without handing over the keyboard — every file write and command is one you saw, and any step can be undone
value.zh: 拿到 agent 速度的改动，但键盘没交出去：每次写文件和跑命令你都看过，任何一步都能撤销
